title: Huawei Convicted in the US: What the Verdict Means | Global Meridian
description_html:
A federal jury in Brooklyn has found Chinese tech giant Huawei guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and of bank fraud, but cleared it of the most serious racketeering charge. We explain what the verdict says, what it does not, how it affects countries and phone and network users around the world, and what you should do.

Chapters

3:09 What should you do?
3:35 My Take
4:05 Outro

Sources
According to official reports and statements: US Department of Justice and court reporting on the Huawei trial, Huawei statements, the governments of Canada, the United Kingdom, India and European Union members.

This is an extract of our Daily Crux of 27 November 2026. Watch the full Daily Crux for the other stories and world headlines.
